hard_requirement: ZERO VISIBLE FRAMES. All images must contain only the artwork, never its physical frame, mat, mount, wall, museum label, display hardware, or gallery setting.
hard_fail: mat/mount and ornamental border outside original composition
reflections or glare caused by shooting through glass
frame hidden by CSS overlay or presentation-only mask without approved artwork-only source
unknown edge status represented as approved
workflow: Select an artwork independently from approving its image reproduction
Identify clean unframed high-resolution source from authoritative museum or credible open provider
Inspect the four edges and whole image at original pixel resolution, not a thumbnail
Reject and record any framed PHOTO SOURCE without rejecting its underlying artwork or earlier user selection
Locate an alternate genuinely frame-free source; if none exists, keep image candidate BLOCKED/RESEARCH_MORE
Use a lossless trim only if it preserves 100 percent of painted surface and is individually inspected; prefer clean original source
Verify provenance, exact object identity, documented rights, sharpness, tonality, colour, damage, watermark, compression, checksum
No publication without separate editorial approval and permission
notes: A visually framed image may be retained as an archival evidence link, but must NEVER be displayed as a painting candidate or presented as usable artwork. Existing users' painted border integral to the historic image is not the physical museum frame; preserve the painted composition.
